summary: Behaviour Interactive and Bethesda's acrobatic grindhouse-style shooter starring Rubi Malone.

entries.title: WET
entries.definitive_edition: Original Xbox 360/PlayStation 3 release; Xbox 360 selected as primary route

emulation.emulator: Xenia or RPCS3 where legal and stable
emulation.notes: Original hardware remains the reference route; use emulation only for owned-copy preservation or scaling.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Seventh-generation console release, potentially improved through emulator scaling

primary.why: WET released on PlayStation 3 and Xbox 360, while a planned PSP version was cancelled. With no sourced content difference between the released console versions, Xbox 360 is the practical primary pick and PS3 is an equivalent alternative.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Xbox 360 version on original hardware; use PS3 as an equivalent original-console route if that is the available copy.

entries.remaster_caveats: No PC port or modern remaster is documented in the cited public source; the PSP version was planned but cancelled.
